# apple_game_center_detail (Resource)

Turns Game Center on for an app and puts the app in a Game Center group. An app has one Game Center detail: the resource creates it, or manages the existing one. App Store Connect can't turn Game Center off again, so destroying the resource only takes the app out of its group. Import it by the app's ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_detail" "example" {
  app_id               = data.apple_app.example.id
  game_center_group_id = apple_game_center_group.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center group the app shares leaderboards and achievements with, e.g. `apple_game_center_group.example.id`.

### Read-Only

- `arcade_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app is on Apple Arcade.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center detail.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_detail.example
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_detail.example 1234567890
```
